BUNGUBUNG, CESC) IV Regional Director DILG-Region XII Dear Regional Director Bungubung: 25 JAN 2018 This has reference to your letter dated 09 June 2017 requesting for this Department's legal opinion regarding the continued physical absence of Mayor-elect Bryan Reganit, Municipality of Maitum, Sarangani Province as there is a standing warrant of arrest issued against him by the Regional Trial Court (RTC). To answer your query, may we invite you to Section 46 of Republic Act (RA) No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991 " (LGC) which provides that: xnx... the vice-governor, city or municipal vice-mayor, or the highest ranking sangguniang barangay member shall automatically exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the local chief executive concerned, except the power to appoint, suspend, or dismiss employees which can only be exercised if the period of temporary incapacity exceeds thirty (30) working days. (b) Said temporary incapacity shall terminate upon submission to the appropriate Sanggunian ofa written declaration by the local chief executive concerned that he has reported back to office. In cases where the temporary incapacity is due to legal causes, the local chief executive concerned shall also submit necessary documents showing that said legal causes no longer exist. Based on the aforequoted provision of law, in case of temporary vacancy in the Office of the local chief executive (LCE), the vice-governor, city or municipal vice-mayor, or the highest ranking sangguniang barangay member, as the case may be, shall assume the office of the LCE concerned. Moreover, this issue was long-settled by this Department in its past opinions. For your reference, please find the herein attached DILG Legal Opinion No. 20, s. 2013, which discussed

that warrant of arrest coupled with absence and non-performance Of the duties of the mayor is considered a "physical" or "legal reason" under Section 46 (a) of the LGC. Given that Mayor-elect Alexander Bryan B. Reganit is temporarily incapacitated to assume his office, Vice Mayor-elect, by provision of law, should assume the Office of the LCE concerned. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, By Autho of the Secretary: A. PANADERO Undersecretary 2018-0'- Legal/O%p
